key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people were evacuated ahead of landfall.
21 deaths were attributed to the cyclone.
Subsequent floods caused 23 deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
National highways and important roads were closed to regular traffic.
Fierce winds and storm surge hit coastal areas; torrential rainfall caused flooding.
evidence_snippets: On 12th October 2013, Phailin Cyclone crossed the coastline south of Brahmapur in Odisha.
Gopalpur observed a gust of 185 kph at the storm’s northern eyewall.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh were affected; flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
